retention_tricks: Fast Pacing: Rapid cuts every 1-3 seconds to maintain momentum.
Dynamic Text: On-screen text overlays reinforcing key points or adding humor.
Sound Design: Engaging background music, sound effects, and voiceovers.
Mystery/Reveal: Pose a question or problem early, reveal the answer later.
Constant Change: Varied camera angles, visual elements, or scene changes.
Loopable End: Design the ending to seamlessly transition back to the beginning.
